text:
Closing as done and stale-open. Verified rather than recalled: both 770eb7b (type aliases added to the reference-scope alternation) and 7b13dfc (the measured NON-change declining to add opaque, because twelve of thirteen opaque types are already reachable via their companion and the thirteenth would name 12 of 13 modules) are ancestors of main.

m1 declined to close this itself, citing the time it closed a bead on its own say-so and had to reopen it. That restraint is why I am closing it rather than it -- and the second commit remains my favourite artifact of the day: a deliberate non-change with the measurement attached, so the next person to notice the omission finds the answer instead of rerunning the experiment.
